commands.name: open_excel
commands.description: Launch or attach to Microsoft Excel.

commands.name: open_workbook
commands.description: Open a workbook from a specific path.

commands.name: select_sheet
commands.description: Select a worksheet in the active workbook.

commands.name: go_to_cell
commands.description: Move the active Excel selection to a specific cell.

commands.name: go_right
commands.description: Move the active selection one column to the right.

commands.name: go_down
commands.description: Move the active selection one row down.

commands.name: next_row_from_start
commands.description: Move to the next row and return to the start column for the current data-entry block.
